Hmm, try removing the datadir one last time please 🙈 Sorry for all that This works for me. i'm a noob at running consensus clients, any idea where to start to debug this error importing genesis into lighthouse? ``` CRIT Failed to start beacon node reason: Unable to parse genesis state SSZ: OffsetOutOfBounds(3916701587) ``` could you give us some more info? What flags are you using? What testnet is this for? Which genesis.ssz are you using? ah yes, context is good - i'm trying to add support for merging in hive and so i'm building off this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/481 so i'm using these flags: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/blob/f9c983ea4b33153c6b5374a8fcfc2277aa136b90/clients/lighthouse-bn/lighthouse_bn.sh#L44-L60 the genesis.ssz is being generated in hive this is my wip diff that has managed to make the genesis.ssz unreadable: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/compare/master...lightclient:merge-testnet?expand=1 okay apparently it was cause by me change `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH = 10` to `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH = 0` <a:pepeMeltdown:840031953650581526> any idea why? That will change the format expected in the genesis state. With Altair fork at 0 the genesis state must be an Altair state but if Altair fork is later the genesis state needs to be a phase0 state. Last I checked proto’s testnet genesis creator tool only created phase0 states so I’ve wound up having to start from phase0 in my testnets. got it, thanks <@!340345049063882753> ! I see similar errors when running Nethermind. Does anyone have any ideas?
